# External figure provenance

The files in this directory are cropped, rasterized reproductions of figures
from the cited NIST publications. They are supporting scientific figures, not
screenshots of this project's implementation.

Attribution notice: Republished courtesy of the National Institute of
Standards and Technology, U.S. Department of Commerce. NIST's technical-series
reuse guidance is available at
<https://www.nist.gov/nist-research-library/nist-publications>.

## `nist-passive-idps-architecture.png`

- Source: Karen Scarfone and Peter Mell, *Guide to Intrusion Detection and
  Prevention Systems (IDPS)*, NIST SP 800-94 (2007).
- Reproduced item: Figure 4-3, “Passive Network-Based IDPS Sensor Architecture
  Example”, printed page 4-7 (PDF page 41).
- DOI: <https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-94>
- Official PDF: <https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/legacy/sp/nistspecialpublication800-94.pdf>
- Local processing: the figure region was rasterized at 300 dpi and cropped;
  the diagram content was not redrawn or altered.

## `nist-iot-capture-architecture.png`

- Source: Paul Watrobski, Murugiah Souppaya, Joshua Klosterman, and William
  Barker, *Methodology for Characterizing Network Behavior of Internet of
  Things Devices*, NIST IR 8349 (2025).
- Reproduced item: Figure 4, “Example capture architecture”, printed page 26
  (PDF page 34).
- DOI: <https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.IR.8349>
- Official PDF: <https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ir/2025/NIST.IR.8349.pdf>
- Local processing: the figure region was rasterized at 300 dpi and cropped;
  the diagram content was not redrawn or altered.
